segments.source: I would choose the current Elizabeth PL92T for a household making two or three espresso and milk drinks that wants dual boilers, timed shot buttons, programmable preinfusion and onboard temperature controls without an E61 footprint. The main compromise is first-cup readiness: independent reviewers recommend a longer preheat than the early ready signal suggests. Choose it for control once warm; compare another machine if a spontaneous first drink, plumbing or automatic beverage weighing matters more. Lelit US and Clive listed it at $1,799.95 on October 30, 2026; confirm the exact model and offer before buying.

segments.source: Yes. Separate coffee and steam boilers allow overlap. That removes the single-boiler temperature transition, but does not establish unlimited milk capacity or an automatic two-drink service time.
segments.context: Yes. Separate coffee and steam boilers allow overlap. That removes the single-boiler temperature transition, but does not establish unlimited milk capacity or an automatic two-drink service time.

segments.source: Separate boilers remove a temperature transition; they do not dose coffee, organize pitchers or clean the wand. For a normal two-person order, prepare cups and the next dose before starting. Brew and steam consecutively while learning, then overlap them when stopping both tasks feels controlled.

segments.source: The small-pitcher benchmark in the evidence table is useful because it gives a defined amount and target temperature. It still does not tell us what happens after several large pitchers, or how quickly the steam circuit recovers between them. A short test and a steam-boiler capacity are different forms of evidence.

segments.source: Choose a pitcher and milk quantity that let you learn the wand’s response. Wipe and purge as the applicable manual directs. If a sequence slows, allow recovery rather than compensating by stretching the same milk repeatedly. For entertaining, ask a dealer to demonstrate the size and number of drinks you expect; specify the order rather than asking whether the machine has “good steam.”
